Observation 1: The most striking feature in Figure 1 is the leap in performance when using ground-truth location, reaching a level similar to the state-of-the-art LiDAR-based methods, suggesting the localization error is the key factor in restricting monocular 3D detection.

Observation 3: We found that, except for localization error, there are also some other vital factors, such as dimension estimation, restricting monocular 3D detection (there is still 27.4% room for improvements even we use the groundtruth location).
